display_name: The whole Apportionment Act 1928 (ss 1-7): what is apportionable, the day-by-day accrued part, when it is payable and how it is recovered
scope: Every provision of the Act as printed in SSO's PDF, current version as at 05 Oct 2026 (2020 Revised Edition): ss 1-7. Inert: the long title and s 1. The s 2 classification of a payment (rent, annuity, dividend) is an input; the s 2 exclusion of a return of capital and the deemed daily accrual of dividends are encoded. No date is gated: the Legislative History lists no amending Act since 1928. NOT encoded: nothing in the Act.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-05 (tests-independent.l4, expectations written from the source before the encoding was read, in independent-expectations.md); its findings and their triage are in INDEPENDENT-TEST-REPORT.md. The source is SSO's unofficial consolidation. The pipeline has not been run.
